name: Sackbut
overview: The sackbut, identified in Daniel 3 alongside instruments like the cornet, flute, harp, psaltery, and dulcimer, is described as a stringed musical instrument used in orchestral settings. These verses reveal that the sound of the sackbut was part of the music that accompanied the king's decree for all peoples to worship the golden image, underscoring its role in public and ceremonial contexts. The consistent listing of the sackbut emphasizes its importance among the musical instruments of the time, reflecting the cultural practices that the faithful were called to resist in obedience to God.
